description: End-to-end identity and trust verification workflow leveraging network intelligence and risk signals for Trust-as-a-Service (TaaS) scenarios.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for an identity verification session

profile_id.description: Persistent user or entity profile identifier

network_context_id.description: Identifier for captured network intelligence context (IP, device, ASN, etc.)

risk_assessment_id.description: Identifier for a specific risk assessment associated with a session

verification_request_id.description: Identifier for a submitted verification request (e.g., KYC check)

decision_id.description: Identifier for a final trust/verification decision

functions.name: init_verification_session
functions.description: Initialize a new identity verification session, capturing initial channel and network metadata.

profile_hint.description: Optional basic identity hints if known prior to full profiling.

external_user_id.description: Caller-side user identifier (e.g., app user ID).

phone_number.description: E.164 formatted phone number if available.

entry_channel.description: Channel where the verification is initiated.

network_snapshot.description: Initial network-related attributes captured at session start.

fingerprint.description: Derived device fingerprint or browser fingerprint.

location_hint.description: Coarse-grained location from client, if available.

policy_context.description: Contextual info used to route to the correct verification policy.

functions.returns: New verification session with session_id, optional profile_id, and initial status.

functions.name: enrich_network_context
functions.description: Enrich raw network telemetry (IP, ASN, device) into a structured network intelligence context.

include_history.description: If true, include historical intelligence on this network and device.

functions.returns: Enriched network context with network_context_id, geo, reputation scores, and related profiles.

functions.name: create_or_link_profile
functions.description: Create a new identity profile or link to an existing one using provided identifiers and enriched network context.

identity_attributes.description: Identity attributes used to search/link or create profile.

linking_strategy.description: Strategy to use for matching with existing profiles.

functions.returns: Profile linkage result with profile_id, match confidence, and any merged identities.

functions.name: run_risk_assessment
functions.description: Execute a composite risk assessment using identity, network intelligence, and behavioral signals.

event_sequence.description: Key events in this session used for risk scoring.

pattern_id.description: Reference to a precomputed behavior pattern.

risk_factors.description: Risk factor toggles or weight overrides.

custom_weights.description: Optional custom weights for each risk dimension.

functions.returns: Risk assessment with risk_assessment_id, risk scores per dimension, and recommended actions.

functions.name: submit_verification_request
functions.description: Submit a verification request (eKYC/eKYB/step-up check) to internal or external verification providers.

verification_plan.description: Definition of what checks to run.

provider.description: Preferred provider or integration key for this check.

attachments.description: Identity artifacts required for verification (documents, selfies).

functions.returns: Verification request with verification_request_id, list of dispatched checks, and initial statuses.

functions.name: get_verification_status
functions.description: Retrieve the latest status of an in-progress verification request and its constituent checks.
functions.returns: Current verification status with per-check results, errors, and overall progress.

functions.name: evaluate_verification_decision
functions.description: Evaluate verification outcomes, risk scores, and policy rules to generate an approval/deny/review decision.

policy_overrides.description: Optional ad-hoc policy overrides for this session.

decision_metadata.description: Additional contextual info used during decisioning.

jurisdiction.description: Primary regulatory jurisdiction for this decision.

functions.returns: Decision payload with decision_id, outcome, reasons, and any applied policy rules.

functions.name: list_sessions
functions.description: List verification sessions filtered by profile, status, and time window.
functions.returns: Paginated list of sessions with summary status and associated risk bands.

functions.name: get_session_details
functions.description: Get full details of a verification session, including linked profile, network context, risk, and decisions.

include.description: Optional sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Comprehensive session object with optionally expanded related entities.

functions.name: cancel_verification_session
functions.description: Cancel an in-progress verification session and propagate cancellation to running checks where possible.

reason_details.description: Free-text description with more detail about the cancellation.

propagate_to_providers.description: Whether to attempt to cancel external provider checks.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation with updated session status and list of affected checks.

functions.name: retry_verification_check
functions.description: Retry a failed or inconclusive verification check, optionally with a different provider or configuration.

check_id.description: Identifier of the specific check within the verification request.

provider_override.description: Optional override provider key for the retry.

updated_attachments.description: Optional updated documents/selfies to use for retry.

reason.description: Reason for retry, used for audit.

functions.returns: Retry operation result with new check instance identifiers and updated status.

functions.name: rollback_decision
functions.description: Rollback or supersede a previous verification decision, typically after dispute or new intelligence.

comment.description: Explanation for audit and downstream consumers.

new_outcome.description: Optional immediate new decision outcome to apply.

functions.returns: Rollback confirmation with updated decision state and references to superseding decisions if any.

functions.name: update_trust_profile
functions.description: Update the long-term trust profile with new risk outcomes, labels, and network intelligence history.

risk_labels.description: Add or remove risk labels associated with this profile.

source.description: System or analyst that added/removed the label.

network_history.description: Append new network contexts associated with this profile.

limits_adjustment.description: Adjust profile-based risk and transaction limits.

performed_by.description: System or analyst performing the update.

functions.returns: Updated trust profile summary with current labels, risk tier, and limits.

functions.name: bulk_import_verifications
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple verifications from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined verifications, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_verifications
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of verifications matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped verifications with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_verifications
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of verifications with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_verifications
functions.description: Export a filtered set of verifications to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_verifications_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across verifications with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with verifications hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_verification_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on verification lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_verification_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing verification subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_verification_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a verification subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_verification_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single verification with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across verifications for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_verification_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of verifications.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_verification_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to verifications with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of verification jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_verification_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight verification job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_verification_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a verification (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_verification_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive verification change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_verification_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a verification approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_verification_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a verification, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_verification_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a verification, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_verification
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a verification for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_verification_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a verification from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_verification_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over verifications (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched verifications.

functions.name: build_verification_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over verifications data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_verification_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern verification behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_verification_policies
functions.description: List policies governing verifications with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_verification_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a verification and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
